Hartlaub and Finsch Beitrag zur fauna Centralpolynesiens. Ornithologie der Viti, Samoa und Tongainseln

Plate 3 Tafel III

  • Fig.1. Didunculus strigirostris Jard. (Coll. Dr. Sclater) Didunculus strigirostris (Jardine, 1845)
  • Fig.2. Porphyrio vitiensis. Peale (Bremer Mus.) Valid name Porphyrio melanotus samoensis Peale, 1848
  • Fig.3. Rallus pectoralis Less. (Mus. Godeffroy) Valid name Lewinia pectoralis (Temminck, 1831)
  • Fig 4. Rallina poeciloptera Hartl. Valid name Nesoclopeus poecilopterus (Hartlaub, 1866)
  • Fig.5. Puffinus nugax. Sol. Valid name Puffinus assimilis Gould, 1838
  • Fig.6. Dysporus sula. Linne.(Bremer Mus.) Valid name Sula leucogaster (Boddaert, 1783)
